name: Glossary
description: The domain vocabulary a project declares, and the words it rejects in their place.

scenarios.title: An entry reaches the files its includes cover, under the name it carries
given: a glossary carrying Global and a named subdomain, each with include globs
scenarios.when: the entries are resolved against the base
scenarios.then: each answers the files its globs cover, Global under that name and the subdomain under its own

scenarios.title: A subdomain stands in for Global where both name one term
given: Global and a subdomain covering one file and declaring the same term
scenarios.when: the effective vocabulary for that file is worked out
scenarios.then: the subdomain's term replaces Global's outright, its rejected words included

scenarios.title: A missing glossary is a broken reference line
given: a path where no glossary was written
scenarios.then: the path is named as one holding no glossary

scenarios.title: A glossary that will not parse
given: a glossary file that is not readable JSON
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable

scenarios.title: A file declaring no glossary at all
given: readable JSON with no glossary in it
scenarios.then: the file is named as declaring no glossary

scenarios.title: The root arrives absolute
given: a glossary named by an absolute path that is not there
scenarios.then: the path answers relative to where the run started

scenarios.title: Order is all that decides which vocabulary is laid over which
given: Global and a subdomain covering one file and declaring the same term
scenarios.when: the entries are read in the reverse of the order the specification writes them
scenarios.then: Global's term replaces the subdomain's, which is why Global is written first

scenarios.title: The specification spelling a word is not a use of it
given: findings against the glossary's own file and against a source file, for a word the glossary spells
scenarios.when: the uses among them are worked out
scenarios.then: the one at the line the glossary spells the word on is set aside, and the other stands
